items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: A permit was issued for a 5plex condo development at 2820 Florence Avenue, valued at roughly $1.38 million, adding multi-family housing to the neighborhood.

items.headline: Council weighs possible lawsuit against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss a potential legal case naming major fire apparatus manufacturers, including Pierce, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer, and Golden State Fire Apparatus, along with their industry trade association.

items.headline: Council to weigh 408-unit housing project on El Camino Real
items.summary: Santa Clara City Council is set to hold a public hearing on a prezone, general plan designation, annexation, and subdivision map for 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under state environmental law.

items.headline: City in talks with school district over Cubberley site
items.summary: The City Council held a closed session on real estate negotiations with Palo Alto Unified School District over the Cubberley Community Center site at 4000 Middlefield Road, covering possible purchase, exchange, or lease terms.

items.headline: Public art project reviewed for Hillview/Arastradero development
items.summary: The Public Art Commission reviewed a public art component of a private development project at 3415-3431 Hillview Avenue and 900-910 Arastradero Road, with a presentation from the project's art consultant and the developer, Harvest Properties.

items.headline: Campbell to split road resurfacing costs with San Jose
items.summary: The council considered a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for street resurfacing, capped at $335,000.
